causalAutopsy.notes: Not introduced by a change. The notice text was written once for a single kind of hold and then reused when a second kind was added, so it promised a retry that only one of them receives. Invisible because the wrong half of the promise is the quiet one: the operator waits, nothing arrives, and the reply is deleted after six hours. Found by grouping the held-origin audit by lifecycle, which showed 152 direct-path operations with zero recovery attempts against 30 forwarded ones with recovery on every single one.
